topic: The Invisible Waves Moving Beneath the Ocean
script:
The ocean looks calm at the surface. But beneath the ocean, enormous waves can travel through layers of water without anyone on a ship noticing.

Unlike ordinary ocean waves, internal waves move along the boundary between water layers of different densities. The surface may show almost nothing.

Some internal ocean waves stretch across huge distances. As these waves travel, they can carry energy through the deep sea.

When underwater waves encounter slopes and seafloor ridges, they can break and stir the ocean, mixing colder and warmer water.

These hidden ocean waves help move nutrients and heat. Scientists track their signatures with satellites and instruments to understand the living ocean.
